item.title: RockxyBit 0.2.0
item.description:
RockxyBit 0.2.0 for macOS
This release updates the native API request workbench with a capture-to-replay comparison view, git-based collection import and export, and faster editing in the request workbench. It also improves handling of sensitive request data in collection exports and MCP request summaries.
RockxyBit lets you compose and replay requests, inspect responses, organize collections and environments, and review imported API material before using it. Pro Standard and Pro Personal licences continue to unlock the applicable Pro features. Update renewals are not available for purchase in this release.
Requires macOS 26.2 or later. The download is Developer ID signed and notarized.

item.title: RockxyBit 0.1.0
item.description:
RockxyBit 0.1.0 is the first macOS release of our API request workbench.
Create and replay requests, organize them in collections and environments, inspect responses, and keep useful requests for later. Import from cURL, HAR, Postman, OpenAPI, SoapUI, and selected Rockxy captures. Review a request in RockxyBit before exporting a rule file for Rockxy.
The app has a usable free tier. A Pro Standard or Pro Personal licence unlocks additional comparison, request variant, environment matrix, runner, mock server, and Rockxy handoff capabilities. Licence activation and update eligibility are checked through RockxyBE.
Requires macOS 26.2 or later. The download is Developer ID signed and notarized.
